name: My Blind Date is an Elder God!?
source:
For a while now, Emily's life has been hollow, tragic, empty. She wakes, goes to work, eats, goes to sleep - day after day.  Until one day. Until one date.

Henry is strange, and off-putting. Nothing about him quite makes sense. And there might just be a lot more to him than meets the eye...

[From [url=https://astra325.itch.io/my-blind-date]itch.io[/url]]
